levels.E0: HYPOTHESIS — an economic story or an AI hypothesis; no return evidence
levels.E1: EXTERNALLY_DOCUMENTED — independent academic/empirical evidence read from a primary page or abstract; not reproduced here
levels.E2: LOCALLY_REPLICATED — passes PIT and basic economics on our market, data and horizon under pre-fixed conditions
levels.E3: ROBUSTNESS_SUPPORTED — survives other start dates, periods, industries, costs, risk exposures and an independent window
levels.E4: PROSPECTIVE_OBSERVED — economics evaluated on records published before the decision, with enough horizon and power
levels.E5: DEPLOYMENT_ELIGIBLE — pre-set source, statistical, economic and operational conditions met, plus a separate Owner approval

rule: Levels are sequential: an item's grade is the highest level whose criteria AND every lower level's criteria are met. A famous paper never skips a level. Blocking states (SOURCE_BLOCKED, PIT_UNSAFE, PIT_CONTAMINATED, GOVERNANCE_CLOSED) are listed separately and make an item ineligible for a decision whatever its grade.
